newsitem.title: USA: Golden Poultry to remain publicly traded.
newsitem.headline: Golden Poultry to remain publicly traded.

text.p: Gold Kist Inc, a farm cooperative, said on Friday an Alabama Circuit Court will allow Golden Poultry Co Inc remain a publicly traded subsidiary of Gold Kist.
The decision amends a previous ruling that would have requred Gold Kist to buy the 23 percent stake in Golden Poultry that it does not already own, Gold Kist said.
Two poultry producer members of Gold Kist filed suit in 1993 challenging the formation of Golden Poultry as a publicly owned unit of Gold Kist, Gold Kist said.
Gold Kist said Circuit Judge Drayton James said the court could not compel the company to make an equity distrubution to members.
Gold Kist said the court awarded $4.2 million in fees and expenses to the attorneys who represented the plaintiffs.

James amended the order to to reflect Gold Kist's decision to redeem to eligible members $21.2 million in equity from earnings from 1976 through 1983 and $13.5 million of the total was allocated to poultry producing members, the company said.
Gold Kist said James ordered Gold Kist directors and officers, as well as immediate family members, to sell their Golden Poultry stock to Gold Kist and surrender any stock options.
This will affect approximately 309,000 shares of Golden Poultry of the 14.2 million shares outstanding, Gold Kist said.
Final judgement on the case will not be appealed, according to Gold Kist.
